content.short: LOCKON is a crypto asset management tool providing on-chain analysis and automated trades.
content.description: LOCKON analyzes wallet activity on the Ethereum network to help you understand market movements and mirror the trades of top crypto traders. In addition to this capability, the app delivers timely trading notifications from leading traders, so you stay informed about opportunities as they arise. It also provides a straightforward, user-friendly interface to manage your crypto portfolio and place trades.
content.meta: LOCKON analyzes wallet transactions on Ethereum and lets you replicate top traders' trades. Discover LOCKON and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
